$comment: Time-boxed npm-audit exceptions. Each key under `allow` is a GHSA that the CI audit gate tolerates at high or critical severity until `expires`; on and after that date the allowlist is ignored entirely, so a lingering exception re-fails the gate and forces the tracked fix to land. Consumed by scripts/audit-allowlist.mjs, run by .github/workflows/security.yml over the root project and every workers/* package. This is NOT a place to silence real exposure. An entry is legitimate only when the advisory is triaged non-reachable in this app AND its patched release is genuinely unavailable, typically because the fix is newer than the .npmrc min-release-age cooldown. When adding an entry, set `expires` to a date and `tracking` to the issue that will land the fix, and give each GHSA a one-line justification as its value. An empty `allow` map means no exceptions are in force: every high or critical advisory fails the gate.

allow.GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5: zod <4.6.6, only in operator/npm/clio-mcp: @oktopeak/clio-mcp (latest 2.4.0) requires zod ^3 and no 3.x carries the fix; the Clio MCP is enabled on no seat (only _template references clio), so nothing reaches it. Root is fixed (zod 4.6.7).
